summary: The state attorney general says she would ‘not hesitate to enforce’ the five-year ban signed by Governor Kathy HochulThe New York governor, Kathy Hochul, signed legislation on Wednesday that places a five-year ban on the manufacture and sale of toys powered by AI chatbots, including talking stuffed animals, dolls and robots that use the internet to hold conversations with children.The recently re-elected governor, who has also placed a one-year moratorium AI datacenter construction in the state, said that parents shopping for children’s toys “should not have to worry that dangerous chatbots disguised as toys could expose their children to inappropriate conversations, manipulate their feelings or put their privacy at risk”.
